cases.name: Soula Hatsiandrou
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was born in Athens, Greece on December 29, 1959, daughter of Nickolas and Despoina (Limneou) Hatsiandrou. Soula was very proud of her Hellenic roots and a devout Hellenic Orthodox Christian. Soula’s self-driven spirit was demonstrated from a young age as she pursued her education as a graduate from Northeastern University with a degree in Computer Science while working multiple jobs and caring for her young son. She went on to progress through a 20-year career as a Computer Program Manager. Beauty was Soula’s vocation, 10 years ago she left the corporate world in pursuit of her passion and joined Sephora. Her daily interactions empowered thousands to shine outward. Soula loved helping others, especially those that did not have a voice. While living in Tallahassee, Florida for 15 years, Soula relentlessly volunteered for Guardian Ad Litem. Advocating for abused, neglected, and abandoned children in the court and in the community. Soula was a force of nature, a free spirit and the happiest of souls. Her smile would light up the darkest rooms, her joy was infectious and her generosity without bounds. She loved to travel, especially to beach destinations where she would walk for miles collecting seashells and enjoy sunrises and sunsets. She was the definition of a Lady, always fashionable, refined, and sophisticated. She was an avid gardener, a formidable dancer, amazing cook, and lover of nature. Before all else Soula loved her family, children, and grandchild Gaia, who calls her Ama because she was too cool for grandma, and she is her biggest pride and joy."

cases.narrative: On 10/9/2023, her body was found along with her husband after a neighbor called to report seeing flooding for the last few days with water coming from beneath the front door and garage door. The neighbor said he had not seen or heard from the residents.
